xfOmniNav.enable.description: Enable or disable XF OmniNav navigation suite.

xfOmniNav.enableCodeLens.description: Show 1-click clickable CodeLens (e.g. ⬆ Animal.speak) above classes and methods.

xfOmniNav.enableGutterIcons.description: Show visual arrow indicators on classes and methods.

xfOmniNav.enableInlayHints.description: Show clickable InlayHints at the end of declaration lines (disabled by default to prevent duplicate arrows).

xfOmniNav.gutterPosition.description: Position of arrow indicators: 'inline' renders right next to code (leaves breakpoint margin clean), 'glyphMargin' renders in the leftmost margin.

xfOmniNav.enableFineGrainedFolding.description: Enable PyCharm-style independent branch folding across Python, Shell, C/C++, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Go, and Rust (if/elif/else, try/except/finally, #if/#elif/#else, switch/case, select/case, match arms).

xfOmniNav.fallbackOnLspFailure.description: Automatically fallback to AST & workspace symbol engine when LSP returns no definition.

xfOmniNav.indexVirtualEnv.description: Index or resolve symbols inside active virtual environment (.venv, venv, conda, site-packages).

xfOmniNav.supportFileImports.description: Support direct jumping to imported module files and string file paths.

xfOmniNav.showStatusBar.description: Show symbol count and inheritance statistics in status bar.

xfOmniNav.debounceDelay.description: Debounce delay (ms) for document edits and re-analysis.

xfOmniNav.maxSymbolsPerFile.description: Maximum number of symbols to analyze in a single file.

xfOmniNav.enableFileErrorDecoration.description: Enable PyCharm-style file error decoration: displays a red alert badge ('!') and highlights files and folders in red when they contain code errors.

xfOmniNav.fileErrorBadge.description: Badge indicator displayed on files and parent directories containing errors (e.g. '❗', '🔴', '!', or 'none').

xfOmniNav.fileErrorPropagate.description: Propagate error decorations up through the folder hierarchy to parent directories (PyCharm-style).

xfOmniNav.enableCallArgumentInspection.description: Enable PyCharm-style call argument inspection: checks argument counts on function and method calls in Python without requiring type annotations.

xfOmniNav.callArgumentSeverity.description: Severity of argument mismatch diagnostics: 'error' (default) shows prominent red highlight and triggers file error decorations, 'warning' shows yellow squiggly underline, 'information' shows info hints.

xfOmniNav.enableCallArgumentHighlight.description: Render prominent PyCharm-style red background tint, border, and inline error hint for argument mismatches in the active editor.

xfOmniNav.enableMissingArgumentInspectio.description: Check for missing required parameters in Python calls (PyCharm-style).

xfOmniNav.enableUnexpectedKeywordInspect.description: Check for unexpected keyword arguments in Python calls (PyCharm-style).

xfOmniNav.enableParameterInlayHints.description: Display PyCharm-style inline parameter name hints before arguments in Python calls.

xfOmniNav.enableDynamicTypeHover.description: Display rich hover card for dynamically inferred Python / TypeScript variables and factory service references.

xfOmniNav.polymorphicMethodWhitelist.description: Custom method names with polymorphic signatures across classes/services to skip false-positive heuristic call warnings.

xfOmniNav.enableGitPreScan.description: Pre-scan Git modified Python files in background on startup to decorate errors across file explorer tree.
